generationInputs.prompt: A stylized flat design image on a white background depicts a woman rendered in subdued flat colors. She stands with a slightly slumped posture, looking down. Subtle, swirling, almost transparent light grey circular arrows surround her, illustrating a self-defeating loop. In front of the woman, a hand rendered in bold flat colors extends forward, offering a single, vibrant green leaf done in a bold flat color. The overall aesthetic is minimalist illustration with clean lines and a vector art style, conveying a sense of breaking free from negative patterns. The hand symbolizes compassion, and the green leaf represents a way to break the cycle.
